entries.title: I Samuel 26:1
segments: ¶Now the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, saying, "Is David not hiding in the hill of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon?"

entries.title: I Samuel 26:2
segments: Then Saul arose and went down to the Wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the Wilderness of Ziph.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:3
segments: And Saul encamped in the hill of Hachilah, which [is] opposite Jeshimon, by the road. But David stayed in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:4
segments: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had indeed come.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:5
segments: So David arose and came to the place where Saul had encamped. And David saw the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the commander of his army. Now Saul lay within the camp, with the people encamped all around him.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:6
segments: ¶Then David answered, and said to Ahimelech the Hittite and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, saying, "Who will go down with me to Saul in the camp?" And Abishai said, "I will go down with you."

entries.title: I Samuel 26:7
segments: So David and Abishai came to the people by night; and there Saul lay sleeping within the camp, with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. And Abner and the people lay all around him.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:8
segments: Then Abishai said to David, "God has delivered your enemy into your hand this day. Now therefore, please, let me strike him at once with the spear, right to the earth; and I will not [have to strike] him a second time!"

entries.title: I Samuel 26:9
segments: And David said to Abishai, "Do not destroy him; for who can stretch out his hand against the LORD'S anointed, and be guiltless?"

entries.title: I Samuel 26:10
segments: David said furthermore, "[As] the LORD lives, the LORD shall strike him, or his day shall come to die, or he shall go out to battle and perish.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:11
segments: "The LORD forbid that I should stretch out my hand against the LORD'S anointed. But please, take now the spear and the jug of water that [are] by his head, and let us go."

entries.title: I Samuel 26:12
segments: So David took the spear and the jug of water [by] Saul's head, and they got away; and no man saw [it] or knew [it] or awoke. For they [were] all asleep, because a deep sleep from the LORD had fallen on them.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:13
segments: ¶Now David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of a hill afar off, a great distance [being] between them.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:14
segments: And David called out to the people and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, "Do you not answer, Abner?" Then Abner answered and said, "Who [are] you, calling out to the king?"

entries.title: I Samuel 26:15
segments: So David said to Abner, "[Are] you not a man? And who [is] like you in Israel? Why then have you not guarded your lord the king? For one of the people came in to destroy your lord the king.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:16
segments: "This thing that you have done [is] not good. [As] the LORD lives, you deserve to die, because you have not guarded your master, the LORD'S anointed. And now see where the king's spear [is], and the jug of water that [was] by his head."

entries.title: I Samuel 26:17
segments: Then Saul knew David's voice, and said, "[Is] that your voice, my son David?" And David said, "[It is] my voice, my lord, O king."

entries.title: I Samuel 26:18
segments: And he said, "Why does my lord thus pursue his servant? For what have I done, or what evil [is] in my hand?

entries.title: I Samuel 26:19
segments: "Now therefore, please, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant: If the LORD has stirred you up against me, let Him accept an offering. But if [it is] the children of men, [may] they [be] cursed before the LORD, for they have driven me out this day from sharing in the inheritance of the LORD, saying, 'Go, serve other gods.'

entries.title: I Samuel 26:20
segments: "So now, do not let my blood fall to the earth before the face of the LORD. For the king of Israel has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains."

entries.title: I Samuel 26:21
segments: ¶Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Return, my son David. For I will harm you no more, because my life was precious in your eyes this day. Indeed I have played the fool and erred exceedingly."

entries.title: I Samuel 26:22
segments: And David answered and said, "Here is the king's spear. Let one of the young men come over and get it.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:23
segments: "May the LORD repay every man [for] his righteousness and his faithfulness; for the LORD delivered you into [my] hand today, but I would not stretch out my hand against the LORD'S anointed.

entries.title: I Samuel 26:24
segments: "And indeed, as your life was valued much this day in my eyes, so let my life be valued much in the eyes of the LORD, and let Him deliver me out of all tribulation."

entries.title: I Samuel 26:25
segments: Then Saul said to David, "[May] you [be] blessed, my son David! You shall both do great things and also still prevail." So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.
